messages:
marta: Heads-up — the sampleapp onboarding flow is failing when developers swap from REST curl to the JS SDK. It silently drops the `metadata`/optional params and we end up with different generation behavior.
chris: repro? which endpoint + params?
marta: curl works: `curl -X POST /v1/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-1","prompt":"hi","preserve_format":true,"metadata":{"source":"quickstart"}}'`
chris: and what does the SDK call look like?
marta: in node app we do: `client.generate({ model: 'redwood-1', prompt: 'hi', preserveFormat: true, metadata: { source: 'quickstart' } })` — note camelCase on `preserveFormat` (we followed the sdk docs)
sam: oof, so REST expects snake_case but SDK normalizes to camelCase and the runtime only recognizes `preserve_format`. does the server ignore unknown keys?
priya: runtime accepts both in some handlers but not everywhere; for the new batching layer we only surface snake_case because of the protobufs.
chris: can you paste the network payload from the SDK?
marta: here — captured via wireshark dev env: `{"model":"redwood-1","prompt":"hi","preserveFormat":true,"metadata":{"source":"quickstart"}}`
chris: yep that's the bug. SDK isn't converting param names before JSON encode. SDK docs show camelCase examples which is confusing.
priya: confirmation: this will cause the request to match a different codepath in the serving runtime so KV cache keys differ too — explains flakiness in sampleapp.
priya: tagging @deploy-bot to see if we have recent changes to the protobuf mapping.
deploy-bot: BUILD-1234: batching-layer proto change merged in main at 2026-03-18T04:22:11Z — field names canonicalized to snake_case only.
sam: plan: quick fix in SDK to normalize keys (camelCase -> snake_case) at client layer for known param whitelist, then patch sampleapp docs.
chris: agree. short term: we should also make the runtime accept both variants for a grace period and log a warning.
marta: i can open the SDK PR. suggested steps: 1) add a param normalizer util w/ mapping table 2) run unit tests for all languages 3) cut patch release 0.14.1 4) update quickstart snippets to use snake_case explicitly and note the mapping.
priya: i'll add a runtime compatibility shim that warns when unknown keys are present. add a metric so we can see uptake.
sam: who owns the docs change?
marta: i'll handle docs + sampleapp update, assigning to @marta in the PR description.
chris: timeframe?
marta: aiming for PR today, release tomorrow (assuming tests pass). if anyone wants to help run integration tests across dedicated/private stack, that would be great.
sam: i can run dedicated tests this afternoon.
priya: i'll wire the shim and the metric, will need a small deploy window — please coordinate with eng-oncall.
chris: nice catch. add a short blurb in the SDK changelog explaining the parity fix and the reason (proto snake_case).
marta: will do. also adding an explicit example in the README:
```js
// before (buggy):
client.generate({ model: 'redwood-1', preserveFormat: true })
// after (correct):
client.generate({ model: 'redwood-1', preserve_format: true })
```
marta: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
priya: :eyes: monitoring metric name `sdk_param_normalization_mismatch`
sam: ping me in #eng-oncall before the runtime shim deploy.
chris: closing loop — once released, we'll run the quickstart smoke test and update the sampleapp CI to assert both REST and SDK produce identical output hashes (add to regression tests).
marta: noted. i'll post the PR link when ready.
